Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the FIR No.0231/2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Rajinder Nagar in these two bail applications is an outcome of a matrimonial dispute and the parties have arrived at a settlement and in terms thereof, steps have already been taken to get the marriage dissolved between the husband and wife and the first motion petition has already been disposed of on 24.05.2023.

sentences.text: 3. In view of the above, the learned senior counsel for the petitioners urges the Court to dispose of the application making the interim direction granted as absolute.
4. Learned APP for the State, on instructions, does not dispute the above position.

5. Keeping in view the above, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioners, they be released on bail by furnishing Personal Bonds in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each with one Surety Bond each in the like amount subject to the satisfaction of the SHO/Investigating Officer concerned.
6. The bail applications are disposed of in the above terms.
7. The date already fixed as 21.07.2023 stands cancelled.
8. Order dasti under signatures of the Court Master.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MAY 31, 2023/MK

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the FIR No.0231/2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Rajinder Nagar in these two bail applications is an outcome of a matrimonial dispute and the parties have arrived at a settlement and in terms thereof, steps have already been taken to get the marriage dissolved between the husband and wife and the first motion petition has already been disposed of on 24.05.2023.
3. In view of the above, the learned senior counsel for the petitioners urges the Court to dispose of the application making the interim direction granted as absolute.

6. The bail applications are disposed of in the above terms.
7. The date already fixed as 21.07.2023 stands cancelled.
